t: The Essentials Varennes outdoor wall light is a mains-powered exterior luminaire designed to provide reliable illumination for domestic properties. This traditional black wall lantern is ideal for lighting up dark entrances, patios, garages and garden walls, helping to improve home security and visibility. Constructed with a durable aluminium body and a clear glass diffuser, the robust fitting carries an IP44 rating to ensure protection against water splashes and dust. The unit requires 1 x E27 GLS bulb, allowing trade professionals and homeowners to select their preferred brightness level.
b: Traditional Design Enhances Classic Exterior Aesthetics
